question: If Ramesh goes to school at a speed of 25 km/h, he reaches 9 minutes late. If he walks at a speed of 30 km/h, he reaches 9 minutes early. Find the distance between his house and school.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed₁ = 25 km/h ⇒ reaches 9 min late

Speed₂ = 30 km/h ⇒ reaches 9 min early

Time difference = 9 + 9 = 18 min = (18)/(60) = (3)/(10) hours

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance / Speed
